title: Artificial intelligence-assisted surgical simulation system based on non-enhanced computed tomography images in thoracoscopic pulmonary segmentectomies.
summary: AI-assisted surgical simulation evaluated pulmonary-nodule navigation in a clinical context.
ai_technology: LungDimensionGo uses EfficientDet for nodule detection and Mamba-UNet with SegRefiner for CT segmentation and 3D lung reconstruction to support preoperative segmentectomy planning.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The source abstract describes retrospective (125 patients) and prospective (38 patients) cohorts and reports shorter reconstruction and operative times and fewer complications in the AI-assisted group; this single-center comparison does not establish general clinical benefit.
evidence.unknown: This single-institution comparison included retrospective (125) and prospective (38) patients; reported perioperative differences do not establish generalizability beyond the site or prove improved long-term outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: LungDimensionGo uses EfficientDet for nodule detection and Mamba-UNet with SegRefiner for CT segmentation and 3D lung reconstruction to support preoperative segmentectomy planning.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
